evidence: Touches `src/psbt.cpp` which implements core PSBT handling and `SignPSBTInput` used across wallet signing operations.
rationale: Fixes an interoperability bug where valid 65-byte Taproot signatures are rejected during PSBT signing and finalization. According to issue #36507, when external signers emit 65-byte `SIGHASH_ALL` signatures without setting `PSBT_IN_SIGHASH_TYPE`, `SignPSBTInput` falls back to `SIGHASH_DEFAULT` and halts signing with a `SIGHASH_MISMATCH` failure.
